guesses.reason: Short, dense, glossy all-black coat with no visible white markings, medium build, and moderately sized upright ears are typical of a random-bred solid black shorthair.
The sleek jet-black coat and black nose leather resemble a Bombay, but the yellow-green rather than copper eyes and the less rounded head point away from a purebred.
The sturdy medium body and short, plush black coat could reflect some American Shorthair-type ancestry.

breed.appearance: A medium-sized, solidly built cat with a short, glossy, uniformly jet-black coat, black nose leather, and long black whiskers, with no white markings visible. In the photo it is walking toward the camera with its tail held straight up, licking its nose with a bright pink tongue.
breed.fun_fact: Solid black cats are considered good luck in places like Japan and the UK, so adopting Payton could bring some extra luck into your home!
